details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: a mailto: URI could silently attach a local file when
     Thunderbird was the configured handler
     - debian/patches/CVE-2022-4055.patch: remove the Thunderbird special case
       (run_thunderbird() and its callers) from scripts/xdg-email.in, so
       mailto: URIs go to the desktop handler and no URI field is parsed;
       the --attach option is dropped with it
     - debian/patches/tests-xdg-email-thunderbird-passthrough.patch: rewrite the
       autotest case that asserted the removed Thunderbird path so it asserts
       the fixed behaviour instead
     - CVE-2022-4055: unquoted subject= and body= in run_thunderbird() let a
       mailto: URI append a -compose attachment= argument
     - CVE-2020-27748: the attach= field of a mailto: URI was passed straight
       through to -compose attachment=
